name: SHATTER DOME: Autonomous Machine Demolition Series
description: A corporate-sponsored arena combat series featuring decommissioned Iowan Behemoths and other autonomous industrial machines reprogrammed with combat subroutines, pitted against each other in the Meridian Shatter Dome — a repurposed lakefront freight terminal converted into a 40,000-seat arena. The machines are not alive; they are recycled demolition hardware running proprietary combat logic packages sold by Cascadia Iron. Each match ends when one machine is reduced below 30% structural integrity, at which point salvage crews enter the arena to strip the wreckage for parts — which are then auctioned to the crowd.
story_hooks: A salvage engineer who works the post-match cleanup discovers that one of the 'decommissioned' Behemoths contains a proprietary combat logic package that was never legally licensed — tracing its origin leads into a corporate espionage chain.

A Tier 1 teenager who has been watching pirated feeds his whole life wins a black-market salvage auction item and discovers it contains corrupted data from the machine's operational history — including records of an industrial accident that was covered up.

A journalist investigating Cascadia Iron's supply chain finds that the machines being 'decommissioned' into the arena circuit are being pulled from active labor contracts early — and that the workers displaced by those machines were never compensated.
